title: Voice Mimic System demo video
author: Beautiful_Sky_790
selftext:
I've developed a process to combine an actor's actual performance with an AI voice. Unlike regular voice cloning, this allows personalized dialogue that maintains all the nuances of an actor's performance.

Looking for any thoughts, feedback and ideas. Thanks.

comments.author: surpurdurd
comments.body: Is it really that fast, or are you editing out be processing time? Looks almost instant from this video. Also would be nice to hear some before and after, I heard a lot of AI voice, but nothing that demonstrates mimic capabilities.

replies.author: Beautiful_Sky_790
replies.body: Yes, it is that fast. The time between each line is the time it's taking to generate each line. What are you looking for in the before? An AI voice without the mimic ability, the original performance, or something else?

replies.author: surpurdurd
replies.body: The original performance. It's impossible to verify your claim that the original acting is preserved if we don't hear it. The output alone is neat, but if you're claiming fidelity to the input, you should play both so that we can judge for ourselves

replies.author: Beautiful_Sky_790
replies.body:
